Description: Accidental modification of S21 repository via int_samarth admin user
Mitigation_Strategy: Enforce strict read-only HTTP GET verbs, read-only ADT interfaces, and reject mutating requests

Description: Complex ABAP routines in BW transformations cannot be mapped automatically to SQL
Mitigation_Strategy: Flag ABAP routines for manual review; provide AMDP / SQLScript transformation templates

Description: Datasphere CLI version mismatch with Node 20 environment
Mitigation_Strategy: Pin @sap/datasphere-cli compatible release; provide direct REST/CSN fallbacks

Description: Loss of reporting semantics (hierarchies, restricted key figures) during migration
Mitigation_Strategy: Model Analytic Models with explicit measures, variables, and dimension hierarchies

Description: Large delta queues (ODQ) in S21 causing replication lag
Mitigation_Strategy: Utilize ODP delta queue monitoring (ODQMON) and staged Replication Flows
